g.text: I take half-formed ideas and push them until they have a URL.
I'm a product engineer finishing a B.Tech in AI & ML at Chinmaya Vishwa Vidyapeeth,
class of 2027, based in Kochi, Kerala. I build things end to end, from the database
schema to the last screen, and I don't call a project done until it's deployed.
Open to internships and junior product-engineering roles.
